mapper.select: select item_id, request_id, source_module, source_no, summary, source_status, risk_weight, screen_time, create_by, create_time, remark from jc_reply_screen_item where request_id = #{requestId} and del_flag = '0' order by risk_weight desc, item_id asc
select source_module as sourceModule, count(1) as cnt from jc_reply_screen_item where request_id = #{requestId} and del_flag = '0' group by source_module
mapper.delete: update jc_reply_screen_item set del_flag = '1' where request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.insert:
insert into jc_reply_screen_item ( request_id, source_module, source_no, summary, source_status, risk_weight, screen_time, create_by, create_time, del_flag ) values
( #{it.requestId}, #{it.sourceModule}, #{it.sourceNo}, #{it.summary}, #{it.sourceStatus}, #{it.riskWeight}, #{it.screenTime}, #{it.createBy}, sysdate(), '0' )
mapper.select: select count(1) from jc_reply_screen_item where source_module = #{sourceModule} and del_flag = '0'

select dd.dict_label as name, count(1) as value from jc_reply_screen_item i left join sys_dict_data dd on dd.dict_type = 'jc_reply_source' and dd.dict_value = i.source_module where i.del_flag = '0' group by i.source_module, dd.dict_label, dd.dict_sort order by dd.dict_sort
